text:
rachel: installed redwoodctl via Homebrew on my M1 and things are weird. `which redwoodctl` -> /opt/homebrew/bin/redwoodctl but `redwoodctl version` errors 'config not found' and suggests `redwoodctl login`.

tom: sounds like a broken symlink. M1 uses /opt/homebrew; some wrappers hardcode /usr/local/Cellar. What does `ls -l $(which redwoodctl)` show?

rachel: points to /usr/local/Cellar/redwoodctl/0.9.1/bin/redwoodctl which doesn't exist after upgrade.

iker: could also be XDG vs legacy home path. We added XDG support; if REDWOODCTL_HOME not set we prefer XDG_CONFIG_HOME/redwoodctl over $HOME/.redwoodctl. Install wrappers sometimes set REDWOODCTL_HOME in /etc/profile which VS Code non-login shells don't load.

vicky: related bug: `redwoodctl local test --profile=staging` still reads tokens from $HOME/.redwoodctl/default when a host mount exists. Expected precedence: CLI flag > env > mounted dir. Repro:
```
export REDWOODCTL_HOME=$HOME/.redwoodctl_test
mkdir -p $HOME/.redwoodctl
# put a token in $HOME/.redwoodctl/default
redwoodctl local test --profile=staging --mount $HOME/.redwoodctl:/home/dev/.redwoodctl
# inside container, CLI picks default, not staging
```
Result: wrong profile used, tests fail.

tom: action items: 1) Fix Homebrew formula so wrapper uses `$(brew --prefix)` not hard-coded cellar. 2) Make CLI respect explicit `--profile` even if mounted dir has defaults; fix loader merge order. 3) Add postinstall caveat about non-login shells and REDWOODCTL_HOME.

iker: propose also detecting when mounted dir owner is root and token files aren't writable. Options: chown to container user UID on startup, or default to a per-run temp volume and warn. Add `--mount-uid` flag to local test.

vicky: short-term workarounds: `brew reinstall && brew link --overwrite redwoodctl` and set `export REDWOODCTL_HOME=$HOME/.redwoodctl_test` before launching VS Code. For localtest: `docker run -v $HOME/.redwoodctl:/home/dev/.redwoodctl:rw --user $(id -u):$(id -g) ...`.

deploy-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/homebrew-redwoodctl/issues/128 (labels: install, brew, macos).

rachel: CI flagged `cli.install_test` flake when Homebrew prefix is non-standard. Suggest a matrix job with HOMEBREW_PREFIX=/opt/homebrew and /usr/local.

tom: I'll take the formula fix and caveat. iker owns loader precedence change, vicky takes localtest mount heuristics.

iker: will add unit tests for precedence and a small integration that simulates mounted dir owned by root.

vicky: will add `--mount-uid` flag and an explicit warning when mount isn't writable. Also update docs 'Running local test on macOS'.

rachel: marking resolved for now, re-open if brew reinstall doesn't fix M1 installs. :rocket:
